title: Caption Fix Queue
user: Small video teams and community educators reviewing existing SRT/VTT captions before publishing.
smallest_useful_product: A local drag-and-drop SRT/VTT checker that flags improbable repeats, blank runs, unsupported characters, long reading-speed cues, inconsistent speaker names, and glossary mismatches; reviewers accept, dismiss, or repair each flag.
constraints: All parsing is local; checks are explainable and never silently rewrite transcript text.
monetization: freemium — free local checker; one-time Studio unlock for shared glossary files and team review-history export.
